Technical Pre-Qualification Criteria: Bidder must have experience of supply of Structure steel in any industry for which bidder must submit PO copy from end user of last 7 years ending last day of month previo us to the one in which application are invited along with work documentary evidence. · Three similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 22.11 Lakhs. · Two similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 27.64 Lakhs. · One similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 44.23 Lakhs. A) As a documentary evidence, bidder shall submit copy of executed Purchase Order alo ng with documentary proof of successful supply of material, such as: i. Completion Certificate / Customer Acceptance certificate OR ii. GEM consignee receipt and acceptance certificate. OR iii. Tax invoice with proof of receipt of payment like bank statement for the submitte d invoice. 11. Commercial Pre-Qualification Criteria: A) Turnover / audited annual reports: Last three years financial audited reports or Turnover certificate from Chartered Accou ntant (CA) as below:

Average Annual Financial Turnover during the last three years ending 31st March 2026 i.e. FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26: ₹ 44.23 lakh. Bidder shall submit audited annual reports certified by Chartered Accountant (CA) or Tu rnover certificates for above financial years. Turnover certificates should be issued by p racticing CA with membership number, seal and signed. Certificate / document issued by Chartered Accountant will be valid and accepted only with UDIN number. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constituti on shall be taken into account. In this case, the financial turnover during last financial y ear / the average financial turnover during preceding two financial years should be at le ast ₹ 44.23 lakh. Relaxation in Turnover criteria for eligible MSEs/ STARTUPS- Relaxation of 25% in Annual financial turnover to be provided to the qualifying MSEs/ S TARTUPS. Bidder shall submit audited annual reports certified by Chartered Accountant (CA) or Tu rnover certificates for above financial years. Turnover certificates should be issued by p racticing CA with membership number, seal and signed. Certificate / document issued by Chartered Accountant will be valid and accepted only with UDIN number. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constituti on shall be taken into account. In this case, the financial turnover during last financial y ear / the average financial turnover during preceding two financial years should be at le ast ₹ 33.17 lakh. B) Net worth: Net worth of the Bidder firm should not be negative on ‘31st March 2026’. [i.e. The net worth of the Bidder should not be negative in the balance sheet of last financial year (F Y 2025-26)]. AND Net Worth of bidder should not have eroded by more than 30% (thirty percent) in the la st three years, ending on ‘31st March 2026’. [i.e. The net worth of last financial year (F Y 2025-26) should not be less than 70% compared to the 3rd last financial year (FY 202 3-24)]. The bidder to submit the documentary proof e.g. audited balance sheet, P&L account e tc. for the same with Net Worth Certificate duly certified by practicing CA with member ship number, seal, signed and UDIN number. In case the date of constitution/ incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old, the

following will be applicable: · The Net Worth in each of these years should not be negative. · Net Worth in respect of the immediate previous financial year should not have eroded more 30 percent than that of its previously audited financial statement. In case the Bidder has completed financial statements of only preceding year, the claus e of net worth erosion will not be applicable. 12. VIMS (Vendor Invoice Management System) A Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) system is secure online platform, designed to streamline the process of managing invoices from vendors. It ensures efficient invoice capture, approval, and pay ment processing within an organization. The system integrates with enterprise resource planning ( ERP) platforms like SAP to centralize financial data and Government e Market place (GeM Portal). It also provides transparency, allowing for better tracking, auditing, and reporting.
